title: Cosmic Serpent at Midnight
description: A large, ornate blue snake with intricate patterns and glowing yellow spots coils across a rural night landscape. It holds a lit cigarette in its mouth while exhaling a massive swirling cloud of purple smoke containing floating clocks and abstract shapes, set against a starry sky with a full moon and illuminated farmhouses.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal night scene featuring a massive ornate blue serpent with intricate yellow and white dot patterns coiled in a rural landscape. The snake has a cigarette in its mouth and exhales a huge swirling vortex of purple smoke filled with floating clocks and abstract shapes. Background shows a starry sky with full moon, wooden farmhouses with lit windows, and rolling hills. Mystical atmosphere, vibrant colors, intricate details.
